subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: Should the built-in model-facing `write` tool permanently gain the optional `append: true` contract after the two implementation defects are repaired?
rationale: The capability solves a well-proven data-loss workflow, but adding a new model-facing filesystem operation is a durable product/API choice that repository history and contributor proof cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept optional append mode
options.body: Keep overwrite as the default and approve `append: true` once all backends preserve the canonical write and safety contracts.

options.title: Use a separate append tool
options.body: Reject the parallel mode and require a distinct allowlist-visible tool, accepting extra tool surface and duplicated presentation.

options.title: Keep overwrite-only write
options.body: Decline a built-in append primitive and continue relying on read-concatenate-write or trusted `exec` workarounds despite the documented data-loss risk.

recommendation.title: Accept optional append mode
recommendation.body: Keep overwrite as the default and approve `append: true` once all backends preserve the canonical write and safety contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current-main write and sandbox refactor that defines the contract this API must extend.
